item.tib: dbal chen drag po rngam pa'i thugs rgyud las spyi rje khyung gi bzlog pa snang srid zil gnon
item.coloph: spyi rje khyung gi bzlog (zlog) pa zhes bya ba/ las kyi rkyen bgegs bzlog (zlog) byed nas/ kag dang 'tshe rtsub bzlog dang / ltar ngan bzlog (zlog)pa'i mdel thung*/ khyung bzlog (zlog) snang srid zil gnon zhes bya ba/ slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas kyis/ brag dmar g.yel (yer) ba'i mgul du mdzad/ stong (stang) chen dmu tsha gyer med kyis/ phyi rabs las ldan gshen la brgyud pa dge legs 'phel//

item.tib: dbal chen drag po rngam pa'i thugs rgyud las spyi rje khyung gi zlog pa snang srid zil gnon
item.coloph: khyung zlog snang srid zil gnon zhes bya ba/ slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas kyi (kyis) brag dmar g.yer ba'i mgul du mdzad// stang chen dmu tsa gyer med kyis/ phyi rabs las ldan gshen la brgyud pa dge legs 'phel/ shud b+ham//
